topic: Someone finds a time capsule they don't remember burying
text: I don't know how it got there, this box, buried beneath the old oak, a secret I never kept. Hands shaken, I pried it open, dust rose like a whisper of failure. Inside, relics from a life half-lived—a faded photograph, a lock of hair, a note written in ink that’s lost its courage, barely legible. The air between us, thick as it's ever been, demands answers I don’t have. Each item a sentence, each sentence a lie I’ve been living. I trace the edges, feeling the weight of something I can’t quite place, a puzzle missing pieces. The sun dips, shadows stretch, and the urgency to understand deepens with the dark.
